about: Armory talent loadouts (Raider.IO public profile API, talentLoadout): s = the import string the game produced, t = the same build as [entry id, rank] pairs, the shape of a Warcraft Logs talent tree. No character identity is kept. trees = talent_string.tree_stamp of each class tree when the vectors were collected; test_talent_string.py holds a vector only against the tree it was taken from.
